$schema_note: MTower Studio — virtual actor roster. An ACTOR is a reusable face and body (with a LoRA once trained). A CHARACTER is a role in one production; characters are cast from this roster in each production's casting.json. Descriptions here contain face and body only — never costume, props, or story details.

status_values.anchor_approved: one approved anchor portrait defines the face
status_values.lora_trained: face model trained; awaiting test approval

reuse_values.open: may be cast again in other productions (one role per series)
reuse_values.locked_to_role: portrays a real person or a real role; never recast

storage: Media (anchor, training set, LoRA, tests) live in cloud storage at studio/library/actors/<ID>_<slug>/ — see studio/library/README.md

distinctness_rule: Every actor must be clearly a different person. Each actor card carries structured 'traits' using the trait_vocabulary below; the engine ('mtower cast-check') compares every pair of actors of the same gender and age group and blocks new anchor generation when two cards share too many traits. Only actors whose family_resemblance names each other may look related. New anchors are reviewed side by side with the approved roster before approval.
